projectContext: Implement caption-first mode for the voiceover-matcher pipeline. Caption functionality is referenced in architecture (CLAUDE.md Rules 22, 26) but not yet implemented. Currently the pipeline downloads videos, then transcribes with Whisper. Caption-first mode will fetch YouTube captions BEFORE video download, enabling faster matching with lower bandwidth. Key gaps: no caption fetcher implementation, no CAPTION pipeline stage, no CaptionFirstConfig, no caption caching, no language handling, no caption quality indicators. Audio-first mode (src/downloader/audio_first.py) provides a good architectural pattern to follow.

userStories.title: Create YouTube caption fetcher module
userStories.description: Implement a caption fetcher that uses yt-dlp to extract YouTube captions/subtitles. This is the foundation for caption-first mode, enabling transcript retrieval without downloading video content.
acceptanceCriteria: New src/caption_fetcher.py module with CaptionFetcher class
fetch_captions(video_id) method returns caption text with timing info
Support for multiple caption formats: VTT, SRT, JSON3 (auto-converted to common format)
Distinguish between auto-generated and human-uploaded captions via is_auto_generated flag
Handle unavailable captions gracefully with CaptionUnavailableError
Tests verify caption extraction for videos with and without captions
userStories.notes: Created src/caption_fetcher.py with CaptionFetcher class supporting VTT/SRT/JSON3 formats, is_auto_generated detection, CaptionUnavailableError/CaptionFetchError exceptions. 52 tests in tests/test_caption_fetcher.py.

userStories.title: Add CaptionFirstConfig to download configuration
userStories.description: Create configuration dataclass for caption-first mode settings, following the pattern established by AudioFirstConfig. This enables users to enable/configure caption-first behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: New CaptionFirstConfig dataclass in src/config/sections/download.py
Fields: enabled (bool), fallback_to_transcription (bool), preferred_language (str), timeout (int)
Fields: prefer_human_captions (bool), cache_captions (bool)
Add caption_first field to DownloadConfig with __post_init__ conversion
Update config.yaml with caption_first section and documentation
Tests verify config loading and validation
userStories.notes: Created CaptionFirstConfig dataclass with all required fields. Added caption_first to DownloadConfig with __post_init__ dict conversion. Updated config.yaml with caption_first section and documentation. Exported in both __init__.py files. Added tests for defaults, custom values, and dict conversion. All 235 config tests pass.

userStories.title: Implement caption language detection and selection
userStories.description: YouTube videos often have captions in multiple languages. Add logic to detect available languages and select the best match based on user preference.
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionFetcher.list_available_languages(video_id) returns list of available caption languages
Language codes follow ISO 639-1 format (en, es, fr, etc.)
Auto-select matching language from config.transcription.language or caption_first.preferred_language
Fallback chain: preferred_language -> 'en' -> any available language
Log which language was selected and why
Tests verify language selection logic with various availability scenarios
userStories.notes: Implemented list_available_languages() using yt-dlp --list-subs, select_best_language() with fallback chain (preferred -> en -> any), _get_preferred_language_from_config() checking caption_first.preferred_language and transcription.language, fetch_captions_auto_language() for one-call convenience. Added AvailableLanguage dataclass. 34 new tests covering language listing, selection, config priority, and regional codes. All tests pass.

userStories.title: Create CAPTION pipeline stage
userStories.description: Add a new pipeline stage that fetches captions for all video candidates before the TRANSCRIBE stage. This enables early transcript availability without video download.
acceptanceCriteria: New src/stages/caption_stage.py with CaptionStage class following stage pattern
Stage runs AFTER VIDEO_METADATA and BEFORE TRANSCRIBE in pipeline order
Fetches captions for each video in video_candidates list
Stores caption data in state.text_metadata compatible with existing matching
Checkpoint integration: saves fetched captions, resumes from partial completion
Tests verify stage execution and checkpoint behavior
userStories.notes: Created src/stages/caption_stage.py with CaptionStage class. Stage runs AFTER REMIX and BEFORE TRANSCRIBE (between download and transcription). Extracts video IDs from downloaded_videos and downloaded_audio. Fetches captions using CaptionFetcher with config-driven language/timeout. Populates state.text_metadata with caption segments for matching. Checkpoint integration with partial resume support. Added CAPTION to STAGE_ORDER in checkpoint.py. 27 tests in tests/test_stage_caption.py all passing.

userStories.title: Add caption cache for cross-project reuse
userStories.description: Cache fetched captions by video ID to avoid re-fetching the same captions across projects. Follows the global cache pattern used for videos.
acceptanceCriteria: New CaptionCache class in src/caption_fetcher.py or src/cache/caption_cache.py
Cache key: video_id + language code (e.g., 'dQw4w9WgXcQ_en')
Cache stores: caption text, timing info, is_auto_generated, fetch_timestamp
Configurable cache location via caption_first.cache_dir (default: ~/.matcher_caption_cache/)
Cache validation: check caption age, invalidate if older than configurable days
Tests verify cache hits, misses, and invalidation
userStories.notes: Created CaptionCache class extending BaseCache. Cache key format: video_id_language. Added cache_dir and max_cache_age_days to CaptionFirstConfig. CachedCaption dataclass stores all required fields. TTL-based expiration. get_or_fetch() convenience method. 30 new tests in tests/test_caption_cache.py.

userStories.title: Implement caption-to-transcription fallback logic
userStories.description: When caption-first mode is enabled but captions are unavailable, seamlessly fall back to Whisper transcription. Track which videos used captions vs transcription.
acceptanceCriteria: TranscribeStage checks for existing caption data in state before transcribing
Skip transcription for videos with valid captions (caption_source='youtube' in metadata)
Track source in text_metadata: caption_source field ('youtube', 'whisper', 'manual')
New config option caption_first.fallback_to_transcription (default: true)
Log summary: 'X videos used captions, Y required transcription'
Tests verify fallback triggers correctly and metadata is set
userStories.notes: Added _get_videos_with_captions(), _filter_videos_with_captions(), _extract_video_id_from_path(), and _mark_transcription_source() methods to TranscribeStage. Logs caption vs transcription summary. Checkpoint includes caption_count, transcription_count, caption_source_stats. 16 new tests in test_stage_transcribe.py. All 55 transcribe tests passing.

userStories.title: Add caption quality indicators to matching
userStories.description: Caption quality varies significantly between auto-generated and human-uploaded. Add quality metadata that the matching stage can use for confidence scoring.
acceptanceCriteria: text_metadata gains caption_quality field: 'high' (human), 'medium' (auto), 'low' (missing/fallback)
CaptionFetcher sets quality based on is_auto_generated and completeness
Matching confidence can be adjusted based on caption quality (optional config)
Report includes caption quality distribution: 'Caption sources: 50 human, 30 auto, 20 whisper'
Quality saved to checkpoint for analysis
Tests verify quality detection and confidence adjustment
userStories.notes: Added determine_caption_quality() function and caption_quality property to CaptionResult. Quality determined by is_auto_generated flag and segment completeness (density). CaptionStage populates text_metadata with caption_quality field. Added caption_quality_adjustment_enabled, caption_quality_high_boost (+5%), caption_quality_low_penalty (-10%) to MatchingConfig. apply_caption_quality_adjustment() in scoring.py integrated into TieredMatcher at 4 locations. CaptionStage reports quality distribution in summary and checkpoint. 21 new tests: 12 in test_caption_fetcher.py (determine_caption_quality), 9 in test_scoring.py (apply_caption_quality_adjustment). All tests pass.

userStories.title: Add caption fetch retry and error handling
userStories.description: Caption fetching can fail due to network issues or YouTube restrictions. Add robust retry logic with exponential backoff and meaningful error messages.
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionFetcher retries on network errors with exponential backoff
New config options: caption_first.max_retries (default: 3), caption_first.retry_delay (default: 2.0)
Distinguish error types: CaptionUnavailableError (no captions exist) vs CaptionFetchError (temporary failure)
Log detailed error context: video_id, error type, retry attempt
After max_retries, mark video for transcription fallback
Tests verify retry behavior and error classification

userStories.title: Implement caption timestamp normalization
userStories.description: YouTube captions can have irregular timing (overlapping, gaps, inconsistent formats). Normalize timestamps to match the format expected by the matching stage.
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionSegment dataclass with start_time, end_time, text fields (matches TranscriptSegment)
Normalize overlapping segments: merge or split based on configurable strategy
Handle gap segments: insert empty placeholders or extend adjacent segments
Convert various timestamp formats (VTT, SRT, JSON3) to consistent float seconds
Validate segment continuity: no negative durations, start < end
Tests verify normalization with edge cases (overlaps, gaps, malformed timestamps)
